client.business_model: Multi-site outpatient provider of medication-assisted treatment (MAT) for opioid and alcohol addiction
client.client_history: Founded in 2010, SaVida Health has expanded from a single clinic to a multi-state platform providing medication-assisted treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorders. In 2017, Nashville-based private-equity firm Council Capital acquired a controlling interest, funding expansion to more than 20 outpatient centers across Vermont, Massachusetts, Maine, Virginia, and Delaware.

revenue.source: LeadIQ company profile for SaVida Health (https://leadiq.com/c/savida-health/5c6a313b20000097313b8d4d)
revenue.notes: LeadIQ lists estimated revenue in the $50M–$100M range. No other primary or official sources provide figures, so midpoint ($75M) is shown as an approximation.

locations.source: Behavioral Health Business article (https://bhbusiness.com/2020/11/09/...) citing 'over 20 outpatient treatment centers' corroborated by 16 specific addresses on SaVida Health locations page (https://savidahealth.com/locations/)
locations.notes: Website lists 16 locations in five states; multiple news pieces (2020–2024) state the network has grown to ‘over 20’. Using 22 as a conservative figure within that description.

employees.source: LeadIQ employee directory (approx. 165 employees, October 2025) and SignalHire (100-200 range)
employees.notes: Both LeadIQ and other staffing databases place staff between 100 and 200; LeadIQ gives the most precise point estimate at 165.
